retrievalProfile.description: A moody, low-key group portrait featuring dramatic side-lighting and high-contrast shadows against a dark, textured studio backdrop.
triggerTerms: moody studio lighting with deep shadows
excludeWhen: bright and airy lighting is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, layered composition of four individuals in 1980s-era fashion, characterized by a dark, desaturated color palette and intense directional lighting that leaves half of the subjects' faces in deep shadow.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between bright white clothing and a dark, textured background
Layered depth with subjects overlapping in a compact formation
Directional light source creating consistent shadow patterns across all faces
Juxtaposition of formal ruffles, sharp blazers, and western-style embroidery
coreInvariants: Deeply shadowed left side of the frame (viewer's left)
Direct, intense eye contact from all subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged in a diamond-like cluster, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the foreground with a hand tucked into his jacket.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the bright white ruffles on the left, across the central figure's face, to the dark western shirt on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark space above the heads, providing a heavy, atmospheric weight.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and navy blue (background and shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and muted blonde/brown hair
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to desaturated blues, greys, and blacks

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group portrait of four people in 1980s new wave attire (ruffled collars, blazers, western shirts). Use dramatic side-lighting from the right to create deep shadows on the left side of their faces. The background should be a dark, mottled, textured studio wall in charcoal blue.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a clean, thin sans-serif or a bold, geometric display font in white, positioned in the upper negative space to maintain the moody atmosphere.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting directional and high-contrast?
Is the background dark and textured?
Are the subjects' expressions serious and direct?

adjustableVariables: Specific clothing styles (e.g., more punk vs. more formal)
mustRedesign: Ensure no bright colors distract from the moody palette
Maintain the 1980s hair and fashion silhouettes
postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent shadow direction across all subjects
Ensure the white clothing isn't blown out/losing detail
Verify the background texture is subtle but present
Confirm the composition feels balanced yet crowded
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine 1980s fashion silhouettes + dramatic side-lighting + dark textured studio backdrop + film grain texture.
